name: FindFileInFolder
label: Find File in Folder
description: Finds a single file in a folder (and optionally subfolders) that best matches a given criterion such as largest, newest, or first alphabetically.

fields.name: FolderPath
fields.label: Folder Path
fields.description: The full path of the folder to search. Example: C:\Documents\Reports

fields.name: SearchOption
fields.label: Search Option
fields.description: The criterion used to select the matching file. Options: Largest, Smallest, Newest, Oldest, NewestCreated, OldestCreated, FirstAlphabetical, LastAlphabetical. Default: Largest.

selectOptions.label: Largest
selectOptions.description: Find the file with the largest size.

selectOptions.label: Smallest
selectOptions.description: Find the file with the smallest size.

selectOptions.label: Newest Modified
selectOptions.description: Find the most recently modified file.

selectOptions.label: Oldest Modified
selectOptions.description: Find the least recently modified file.

selectOptions.label: Newest Created
selectOptions.description: Find the most recently created file.

selectOptions.label: First Alphabetical
selectOptions.description: Find the first file in alphabetical order by name.

selectOptions.label: Last Alphabetical
selectOptions.description: Find the last file in alphabetical order by name.

fields.name: FileFilter
fields.label: File Filter
fields.description: One or more file patterns separated by semicolons (;). Examples: *.pdf or *.pdf;*.docx. Default: * (all files).

fields.name: IncludeSubfolders
fields.label: Include Subfolders
fields.description: When true, searches all subfolders recursively. When false, only the top-level folder is searched. Default: true.

fields.name: ResultFilePath
fields.label: Result File Path
fields.description: The full path of the file that best matches the search criteria. Empty if no matching file is found.
